title: Dubai off-plan project register and DLD recorded sales, 2026 (snapshot of 13 November 2026)
description:
Snapshot, taken on 13 November 2026, of seven datasets about Dubai off-plan property compiled by Certified Poor from Dubai Land Department (DLD) open data.

- Project register 2026 (373 projects): developer, district, status, escrow status, % built, registered units, declared value, start date, filed completion date.
- Recorded off-plan purchases 2026 by project (1,461 projects): count, median price, median price per sq ft, unit mix.
- Home prices 2026 by area and home type (470 rows): count, median, quartiles, median price per sq ft.
- Projects without an open escrow account (101).
- Buying costs by project (259).
- Land plot sales 2026 by project (200).
- Daily history of the register counts.

Prices are what buyers paid as recorded by the DLD, not asking prices. Medians are calculated from individual sales. Source: Dubai Land Department open data. Method: https://certifiedpoor.com/insights/how-we-read-the-dld-register The current, regularly updated files are at https://certifiedpoor.com/open-data/
